entries.title: Psalms 143:1
segments: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer O LORD; give ear to my supplications; in Your faithfulness [and] in Your righteousness answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 143:2
segments: And do not enter into judgment with Your servant, for in Your sight no one living is just.

entries.title: Psalms 143:3
segments: For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has beaten my life down to the ground; he has made me dwell in darkness, as those long dead.

entries.title: Psalms 143:4
segments: And my spirit has fainted within me; my heart has become weary within me.

entries.title: Psalms 143:5
segments: I remember the days of old; I think on all Your works; I muse on the work of Your hands.

entries.title: Psalms 143:6
segments: I stretch forth my hands to You; my soul [thirsts] after You like a thirsty land. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 143:7
segments: Hear me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails; do not hide Your face from me, lest I be like those who go down into the Pit.

entries.title: Psalms 143:8
segments: Cause me to hear Your loving-kindness in the morning, for I do trust in You; cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to You.

entries.title: Psalms 143:9
segments: Deliver me, O LORD, from my enemies; I flee to You to hide me.

entries.title: Psalms 143:10
segments: Teach me to do Your will; for You [are] my God; Your Spirit [is] good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 143:11
segments: O LORD, for Your name's sake enliven me; for Your righteousness' sake, bring my soul out of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 143:12
segments: And out of Your mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul; for I [am] Your servant.
